T: Chasing pirate gold. Stopping for seconds.
D: A gang of kids follow an old treasure map to find a pirate's lost ship.
P: Serve the snacks when Chunk is made to do his dance at the gate.
S: Crisp cheddar shortbread coins with smoked paprika and a little cayenne
Sharp cheddar, butter, flour and smoked paprika rolled into a log, chilled, sliced into coins, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp.
Creamy clam and potato chowder in mugs, straight from the Astoria docks

Steam the clams in a covered pot with 250ml water for 4 to 5 minutes until open, then strain and keep the liquid. Pick out the meat and throw away any that stay shut. Fry the bacon in a large pot until crisp, then add the onion and celery and soften for 5 minutes. Stir in the flour, then the clam liquid, milk, potatoes and bay leaves. Simmer gently for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the cream and clam meat and heat through without boiling. Season with pepper. Serve in mugs with oyster crackers.
M: Thin crust pizza with Italian sausage, mushrooms, mozzarella and garlic tomato sauce
Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, garlic and oregano, Italian sausage, mushrooms and mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
the Walsh house on the Goon Docks in Astoria

Flathead in a crunchy soda water batter, piled into warm tortillas with chipotle slaw, pickled onion, avocado and lime, a pirate map's worth of crunch. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with 100g mayonnaise and 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold soda water and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, sliced avocado and lime.
W: Chocolate loaf cake hollowed out and filled with chocolate coins, under ganache
Chocolate loaf cake baked at 170C for 50 minutes, hollowed out and filled with gold-wrapped chocolate coins, lid on, covered in chocolate ganache.
Dark chocolate cream truffles rolled in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream with a knob of butter, chilled 3 hours, scooped and rolled into balls, then coated in cocoa, crushed nuts or sprinkles.
Chunk wins Sloth over with a chocolate bar

Chewy peanut nougat and salted caramel loaded with roasted peanuts, dipped in milk chocolate and cut into fat bars, the way Sloth would want them. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter and 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter, then stir through 150g roasted peanuts and press into a lined 20cm tin. Melt 200g soft caramels with 2 tbsp cream and a pinch of salt and pour over. Chill 1 hour. Cut into 12 bars, dip in 300g melted milk chocolate and set on baking paper in the fridge for 30 minutes.
K: Vanilla ice cream topped with root beer until it foams, served with long spoons
Root beer poured slowly over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses until it foams to the top.

s.note: Crisp cheddar shortbread coins with smoked paprika and a little cayenne
s.how: Rub 80g butter into 150g flour, add 150g grated cheddar, a pinch of smoked paprika and cayenne, and bring together. Roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice into coins and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

s.note: Creamy clam and potato chowder in mugs, straight from the Astoria docks
s.how: Steam the clams in a covered pot with 250ml water for 4 to 5 minutes until open, then strain and keep the liquid. Pick out the meat and throw away any that stay shut. Fry the bacon in a large pot until crisp, then add the onion and celery and soften for 5 minutes. Stir in the flour, then the clam liquid, milk, potatoes and bay leaves. Simmer gently for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the cream and clam meat and heat through without boiling. Season with pepper. Serve in mugs with oyster crackers.

m.note: Thin crust pizza with Italian sausage, mushrooms, mozzarella and garlic tomato sauce
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes mixed with garlic and oregano. Top with crumbled sausage from 3 Italian sausages, 150g sliced mushrooms and 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: Chocolate loaf cake hollowed out and filled with chocolate coins, under ganache
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk in 3 eggs and 150g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Cut off the top, hollow out, fill with chocolate coins, replace the lid and cover in ganache of 100g chocolate and 100ml cream.

w.note: Dark chocolate cream truffles rolled in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles
w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with 20g butter. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Scoop and roll into balls and coat in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles.

d.note: Vanilla ice cream topped with root beer until it foams, served with long spoons
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of root beer slowly over each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.
